evidence: The Al2O3 and InTiO films were formed using trimethylaluminum [Al(CH3)3, (TMA)], trimethylindium [In(CH3)3, (TMIn)], and titanium isopropoxide [Ti(OCH(CH3)2)4, (TTIP)] as the Al, In, and Ti precursors, respectively. These precursors were supplied with Ar as the carrier gas, and O2 gas was used as a reactant, where the radio-frequency (rf) plasma was only applied during the supply of O2 gas.
